column1: hereby amended in PART II as follows: -

column2: in  paragraph  (a)  of  that  PART,  by  the  insertion
immediately  after  item  (xxx)  of  the  following  new
item-

“(xxxi) machinery  and  equipment 
including
medical,  surgical  and  dental  instruments,
apparatus,  accessories  and  parts  thereof,
hospital  or  medical  furniture  and  drugs,
chemical and similar items, as recommended
by  the  Secretary  to  the  Ministry  of  the
Minister assigned the subject of Health, as
required for the provision of health services
to  address  the  COVID  19  pandemic,  with
effect from May 20, 2020.”;

paragraph (b) for the words and figures “on or after
April 1, 2019, other than any lease” of the words and
figures “on or after April 1, 2019 but on or before
November 30, 2019, other than any lease”;
by the insertion immediately after sub-item (c) of item
(xi) of paragraph (b), of the following: -

“(d)

rent of residential accommodation.”;
